Benefits section — ground options

All nine rendered on the live page at 1440px, framed on the seam with the solution band so the junction you flagged is visible in every shot.

Light options are a full re-skin, not just a ground swap: the tabs invert to ink-on-light, the body text moves to the ink scale, and the progress line moves from the warm yellow to the accent — that yellow is a dark-ground-only token in the system.

My pick: warm sand, with near-black as the fallback. The page currently runs three dark bands — solution, benefits, closing — and the two adjacent ones are the same hue. Making this one light fixes the clash and gives the page a rhythm rather than a long dark stretch. If you want to keep it dark, near-black is the only option that clearly separates from the gradient above.
